description: This Java class implements a servlet filter (ControlFilter) that manages access control by allowing or redirecting requests based on configured allowed paths, redirect paths, and error codes. It handles URL validation, security checks, and redirection logic within the OFBiz web application framework.

classes.name: ControlFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that enforces an allowlist of URL paths, manages redirection, and handles security checks for incoming HTTP requests within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters such as redirect path, allowed paths, error code, and whether to redirect all traffic.

methods.name: readErrorCode
methods.description: Converts a string error code to an integer, defaulting to 403 if parsing fails.

methods.name: readAllowedPaths
methods.description: Splits a colon-separated string of paths into a set of allowed path prefixes.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main filtering logic that checks request URLs against allowed paths, performs security validation, and redirects or blocks requests accordingly.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs an HTTP redirect to the specified redirect path, handling relative and absolute URLs.
